info_intro.name: About
info_intro.hint: Everything here can also be changed live from the sidebar WebUI panel (no restart, no config-file editing). Saving applies instantly: the framework unloads and re-initialises the plugin, so every takeover point is re-installed with the new settings. The panel also visualises live metrics.

zh.name: 说明
zh.hint: 本插件的一切配置都可以在侧边栏 WebUI 面板里直接修改并热生效——不用重启，也不用改配置文件。点保存即立即应用：框架会自动卸载并重新初始化插件，所有接管点按新配置重新安装。面板还会把各项数据可视化（抢先发送段数、首段发出耗时、每个接管点的熔断状态、以及本轮为什么开/不开深度思考）。

zh.name: ① 观测（零风险，建议常开）

enabled.name: Enable timing and hit stats
enabled.hint: Log per-step latency, segments, early-send and thinking hits.

zh.name: 启用耗时与命中统计
zh.hint: 记录每步/每轮的耗时、段数、抢先发送与思考命中，输出到日志。默认：开。

zh.name: 采样窗口
zh.hint: 内存中保留的最近样本条数。默认：50。

zh.name: ② 流式引擎（提速核心）

force_stream.name: Force streaming for all providers
force_stream.hint: Always fetch responses via the streaming API regardless of provider defaults. Does not change the final reply.

zh.name: 强制所有提供商走流式
zh.hint: 不管提供商本身怎么写，一律改用流式接口收取响应。好处：不再整段等待、首字更快、兼容非标准端点。不改变最终回复内容。默认：开。

early_send.name: Early send (first line visible in ~1s)
early_send.hint: Send each finished message segment as it is generated. Bypasses the framework send path and re-broadcasts ON_MESSAGE_SENT. Use the provider allowlist to roll it out gradually.

zh.name: 抢先发送（首字即刻可见）
zh.hint: 边收边把已成型的消息段发出去，用户约 1 秒就能看到第一句，而不是等整段生成完。会绕过框架发送层（已补齐 ON_MESSAGE_SENT 广播）。建议先用下方「生效提供商」灰度。默认：开。

providers.name: Provider allowlist (empty = all)
providers.hint: Only apply to these provider names/IDs. Empty means all providers.

zh.name: 生效提供商（留空=全部）
zh.hint: 只对列出的提供商名称或 ID 生效，方便灰度测试。留空表示全部。默认：空。

enabled.name: Enable auto thinking
enabled.hint: Score several signals to decide whether this turn needs deep thinking. Off by default because it changes request parameters; turn it on if your provider supports a thinking switch.

zh.name: 启用自动思考判定
zh.hint: 按多信号打分决定本轮要不要让模型深度思考：简单寒暄不用想（更快更省），复杂问题才开（质量更好）。默认关（因为这会改变发给模型的参数，且需要你的提供商支持思考开关）。

style.name: Thinking switch style
style.hint: Providers differ in both field name and accepted values.

zh.name: 思考开关风格（按提供商选）
zh.hint: 不同厂商开思考的字段名与取值范围都不同，选错会被忽略或报错。compatible=通用（默认，只用厂商交集值）；reasoning_effort=OpenAI o 系列（low/medium/high）；deepseek=DeepSeek V4（只有 high/max，插件会自动映射）；enable_thinking=通义/阿里系；thinking_object=Anthropic 或部分网关；vllm_chat_template=vLLM 部署的通义。

threshold.name: Enable threshold (score)
threshold.hint: Enable thinking when score >= this. Higher = fewer thinking turns (faster).

zh.name: 开启阈值（分）
zh.hint: 得分 >= 该值就开思考。调高=更少思考（更快），调低=更多思考（更好）。默认：2.0。

long_message_chars.name: Long message threshold (chars)
long_message_chars.hint: Add 0.5 when a user message exceeds this length.

zh.name: 长消息阈值（字符）
zh.hint: 用户单条消息超过该长度时 +0.5 分。默认：220。

effort_low.name: medium effort from score
effort_low.hint: Use medium intensity from this score.

zh.name: medium 档起点（分）
zh.hint: 得分达到该值时用中等强度（实际发出的档位会按所选风格映射到厂商合法值）。默认：2.0。

effort_high.name: high effort from score
effort_high.hint: Use high intensity from this score. Under the deepseek style, high maps to max.

zh.name: high 档起点（分）
zh.hint: 得分达到该值时用高强度。DeepSeek 风格下 high 会映射为 max。默认：4.5。

max_per_minute.name: Max thinking turns per minute
max_per_minute.hint: Caps thinking turns to avoid token blow-up from prompt tricks.

zh.name: 每分钟最多开思考次数
zh.hint: 防止被「请认真思考」之类的话术刷爆 token。默认：60。

inject_nothinking.name: Explicitly disable when not needed
inject_nothinking.hint: Send an explicit disable flag when thinking is not needed. Some providers reject it.

zh.name: 不需要时显式关闭思考
zh.hint: 本轮判定不需要思考时，主动发关闭参数（更省更快，但个别提供商不认该参数）。默认：关。

zh.name: 开思考时跟随提供商的强度
zh.hint: 关（默认）：判定要思考时，插件按自己算出的档位发强度，可能比你提供商里设的低。开：判定要思考时插件只负责「开」，强度完全用你提供商里配的那个值（设的 max 就用 max，不会改成别的）。两种情况下，「关思考」都照常生效。

en.name: Use the provider's thinking strength
en.hint: Off (default): when we decide to think, the plugin sends the effort it computed, which may be lower than the one set in your provider settings. On: when we decide to think, the plugin only turns thinking on and leaves the strength exactly as your provider configured it (max stays max). Turning thinking off still works either way.

context_ratio_on.name: Context: turn on above baseline ratio
context_ratio_on.hint: Score the context signal when this turn's context exceeds the session's own rolling baseline by this factor.

zh.name: 上下文：超过基线多少倍才算「变长」（开）
zh.hint: 不用绝对字符数，而是和**你这个会话自己的基线**比较。默认 1.6：例如平时 3.5 万，本轮涨到 5.6 万以上才命中。这样对新装用户和重度用户都有效。

context_ratio_off.name: Context: turn off below baseline ratio
context_ratio_off.hint: Cancel the signal once context falls back below this factor. Two different thresholds prevent flapping.

zh.name: 上下文：回落到多少倍以下取消（关）
zh.hint: 和上面的倍数**故意不同**（滞回）：涨到 1.6× 命中，回落到 1.15× 以下才取消，避免在临界点附近每轮抖动。默认 1.15。

context_min_samples.name: Context: warm-up turns before scoring
context_min_samples.hint: Collect this many turns before the baseline is trustworthy.

zh.name: 上下文：攒多少轮才启用基线
zh.hint: 样本不足时不算这个信号，只积累基线（否则前几轮判断不准）。默认 5。

score_last_turn_tool.name: Score: last turn used a tool
score_last_turn_tool.hint: Add this when the previous turn called a tool (multi-step work in progress).

zh.name: 权重：上一轮用过工具
zh.hint: 上一轮调过工具 ⇒ 多半在做多步任务 ⇒ 这一轮可能还要继续，值得思考。默认 +1.0。（取代原来恒定的「工具数 >= N」，那个在一个会话里是常数、不是信号。）

zh.name: ④ 同轮工具并行（默认关）

enabled.name: Enable parallel tool calls
enabled.hint: Run independent tools of the same turn concurrently instead of one by one. Off by default.

zh.name: 启用同轮工具并行
zh.hint: 同一轮里多个互相独立的工具会并发执行，而不是一个个等。默认关。开启后，只要有一个工具被判为不安全，整批就退回串行（最坏情况只是没加速）。

whitelist.name: Whitelist (empty = allow all)
whitelist.hint: Leave empty to allow everything except the blacklist (recommended). Non-empty means only these may run in parallel.

zh.name: 白名单（留空=全部放行）
zh.hint: 留空（推荐）＝ 只要不在黑名单里就允许并行。填了则**只放行名单里的**，其余一律串行。黑名单优先级高于白名单。

blacklist.name: Blacklist
blacklist.hint: Tools listed here always run sequentially. The built-in list is pre-filled, so you can just add or remove entries.

zh.name: 黑名单（留空=用内置默认）
zh.hint: 名单里的工具一律串行。**内置默认值已经预填在列表里**，你直接在它基础上增删即可，不用手抄一遍。（清空列表 = 没有黑名单，全部放行，不推荐。）

match_exact.name: Exact name match
match_exact.hint: Off: a keyword matches if it appears anywhere in the tool name. On: the name must match exactly.

zh.name: 全字匹配
zh.hint: 关（默认）：关键词命中即可 —— 例如 exec 能命中 manage_background_exec。开：工具名必须完全相等，exec 只命中 exec 本身。

max_parallel.name: Max tools per batch
max_parallel.hint: Skip parallelising when a turn asks for more than this many tools.

zh.name: 单批最大并行数
zh.hint: 一轮里工具数超过该值时不做并行（避免同时打太多请求）。默认：8。

reuse_http_client.name: Reuse HTTP client
reuse_http_client.hint: Cache the client instead of rebuilding it every step.

zh.name: 复用 HTTP 客户端
zh.hint: 缓存客户端，避免每个模型步都新建连接池与 TLS 握手。默认：开。

zh.name: 记忆落盘去掉缩进（待验证 · 暂不可用）
zh.hint: ⚠️ 待验证，面板上已锁定、无法开启。实测收益只在多群大规模时才明显：单会话约省 0.7ms、3 会话约 2ms、10 会话约 18ms、50 会话约 100ms；而且它发生在回复发出【之后】，本就不拖慢回复。它与事件循环的交互也尚未充分验证，故先不开放。

en.name: Compact memory dump (pending verification - locked off)
en.hint: Pending verification and locked in the panel. It only pays off at scale: ~0.7ms for one session, ~2ms for three, ~18ms for ten, ~100ms for fifty - and it runs after the reply has been sent, so it never slowed replies down. Its interaction with the event loop is not sufficiently verified either, so it stays unavailable.

zh.name: ⑥ 外观 · 皮肤轮换

wallpaper_enabled.name: Anime wallpaper background (auto-rotate)
wallpaper_enabled.hint: Show auto-rotating wallpapers behind the panel with a soft scrim for readability. Turn off for a plain dark background.

zh.name: 启用动漫壁纸背景（自动轮换）
zh.hint: 面板背景使用动漫壁纸并自动轮换，带柔和遮罩保证文字可读。关掉即恢复纯深色背景。默认：开。

wallpaper_effect.name: Transition effect
wallpaper_effect.hint: random = a different reveal each time (default): iris, wipe, blinds, shutter, zoom or ink. Or pin one: iris = circle opens from a random point; wipe = a lit edge sweeps across; blinds = horizontal bands; shutter = vertical slats opening from the middle; zoom = dolly push; ink = irregular bleed.

zh.name: 切换特效
zh.hint: random=每次随机换一种（默认）：虹膜／斜擦／百叶／中开／推镜／墨渗。也可以固定一种 —— 虹膜=圆形从随机位置张开；斜擦=一道发光前沿横扫；百叶=横向条带展开；中开=竖向板从中缝打开；推镜=镜头推进；墨渗=不规则渗开。

zh.name: 壁纸晃动（自动漂移 + 跟随鼠标）
zh.hint: 壁纸会持续自行漂移（不必移动鼠标），并叠加缓慢的呼吸式缩放；鼠标或手指移动时再叠一层反向位移，像画面有景深。关掉即完全静止。系统开启「减少动态效果」时自动停用。

en.name: Subtle parallax with the cursor
en.hint: The wallpaper drifts slightly with the cursor, plus a very slow breathing zoom, so the scene feels like it has depth. Turn off for a completely still background. Disabled automatically under prefers-reduced-motion.

wallpaper_parallax.name: Wallpaper drift + cursor parallax
wallpaper_parallax.hint: The wallpaper drifts slowly on its own (no cursor needed) with a breathing zoom; moving the cursor or finger adds a further opposite offset, so the scene feels like it has depth. Turn off for a completely still background. Disabled automatically under prefers-reduced-motion.

wallpaper_interval.name: Rotation interval in seconds (0 = static)
wallpaper_interval.hint: Seconds between wallpapers (picked at random each time, never the same twice in a row). 0 keeps the first one.

zh.name: 轮换间隔（秒，0=不轮换）
zh.hint: 每隔多少秒换一张壁纸。默认 8 秒；每次随机挑一张（不会连着出现同一张）。设为 0 则固定显示第一张。

wallpaper_files.name: Wallpapers in rotation (empty = all)
wallpaper_files.hint: Pick thumbnails in the WebUI panel. Selecting exactly one means no rotation. Empty means all wallpapers rotate.

zh.name: 参与轮换的壁纸（留空=全部）
zh.hint: 在侧边栏面板的缩略图里点选。只选 1 张 = 不轮换（固定显示）。留空则全部参与轮换。

wallpaper_splash.name: Opening animation on page load
wallpaper_splash.hint: Every time the panel opens: a randomly picked wallpaper animates in, the plugin name 'KIRA BOOST' reveals with a random effect, and the line 'KiraAI Accelerator' appears underneath. Click anywhere to skip.

zh.name: 进入页面时的开屏动画
zh.hint: 每次打开面板：随机一张壁纸以随机特效入场，「KIRA BOOST」以随机方式显现，下方浮出 KiraAI Accelerator。点任意处可跳过。默认：开。

wallpaper_splash_motto.name: Show an English motto during the opening
wallpaper_splash_motto.hint: Show one of twelve English mottos about speed and streaming, beside the wallpaper. Turn off to keep only the wallpaper and the name.

zh.name: 开屏时显示英文箴言
zh.hint: 从 12 句关于「速度／流式」的英文箴言里随机取一句，配合壁纸显示。关掉则只保留壁纸与名称。默认：开。
